about: h10-instruction-placement-2026-11: where gbrain's brain-first rule must live to be followed, on Claude Code (CLI and Agent SDK), Codex, Hermes and OpenClaw; the instruction-followed endpoints, the report's extra figures (spend, intervals, cost per turn), the lease arithmetic and the preregistered minimum detectable differences.

cmd:
import os, subprocess, sys
run, src, where, *cmd = sys.argv[1:]
tmp, name = os.path.split(run)
mu = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(src), '2026-11-04-matrix-mu')
def link(target, path):
    if not os.path.lexists(path):
        os.symlink(target, path)
link(mu, os.path.join(tmp, '2026-11-04-matrix-mu'))
fake = os.path.join(tmp, 'root', 'docs', 'benchmarks')
os.makedirs(fake, exist_ok=True)
link(run, os.path.join(fake, name))
link(mu, os.path.join(fake, '2026-11-04-matrix-mu'))
sys.exit(subprocess.call(cmd, cwd=os.path.join(tmp, 'root') if where == 'fake-root' else None))
steps.note: The script reads matrix-mu-2026-11's committed receipts by a fixed path, so this links that run's committed folder (read only) beside the scratch copy, and for report-extras.ts also builds a folder tree whose docs/benchmarks/ points at the scratch copy, then runs the script there.

not_rebuilt.reason: It is a text search over each shard's full trial folders, including harness state, workspaces and raw harness logs; those files stayed off the repository (they hold per-trial gbrain tokens), so the search has nothing to run on.
A one-line filter in the preregistration printed them while reading each shard's own results folder before the merge; those per-shard folders are not committed, only the merged results/ is.
Its one line names the output folder's absolute path on the run machine, which no rebuild can reproduce; the counts it prints are in instruction-followed-h10.json, which is rebuilt.

not_rebuilt.what: The Docker goldens and the Agent SDK system-prompt capture
not_rebuilt.reason: They are test logs from building the harness images and running them against a fake model endpoint in Docker; verify runs no Docker.
It was typed from the smoke ledgers and trial records with no script; its per-turn costs feed compute-leases-amended.ts, whose output leases-amended.txt is rebuilt.
